cards.title: Toddlers deserve respect for their unique culture
cards.body: Small children have their own ways of engaging with the world that deserve recognition and respect. Parents should appreciate their child's perspective rather than dismiss or interrupt their activities.

cards.title: Don't buy Grand Theft Auto VI for children
cards.body: Rockstar Games' 18-rated game is filled with explicit sexual content, drugs, and violence unsuitable for kids. Parents should be aware of the game's mature rating and keep it away from children.

cards.title: What children notice about parental honesty
cards.body: Research shows children closely watch their parents' behavior and notice when words don't match actions. Kids are more aware of inconsistency than parents realize.

cards.title: Five lessons babies teach about well-being
cards.body: Babies offer profound insights into happiness and contentment that can improve adult life. Their natural behaviors reveal important truths about well-being.

cards.title: Preparing kids for an AI-driven future
cards.body: Artificial intelligence is reshaping the world and parents need strategies to prepare children. Helping kids understand AI's potential impact is crucial for their future success.

cards.title: Body shame daughters inherit from mothers
cards.body: Girls learn what to think about their bodies by observing the women they love. Mothers' attitudes toward their own bodies directly influence their daughters' self-image.

cards.title: How families can worsen mental health problems
cards.body: Decades of research show ordinary family dynamics can shape depression and psychosis in children. Understanding these patterns helps parents protect their children's mental health.

cards.title: Letting go of your children comes with challenges
cards.body: Parenting shifts as children grow, bringing both challenges and growth opportunities for parents. The process of letting go requires reflection and emotional work.

cards.title: Managing generational differences during holidays
cards.body: Different generations bring conflicting expectations to family gatherings and holiday traditions. Learning to navigate these differences strengthens family connections.

cards.title: When your adult child pulls away
cards.body: It can be painful when adult children reduce contact with parents. Here are strategies to manage this difficult situation and maintain connection.
